networkDrive.inactive: Only effective when “Network drive” is selected above.

eplan.title: EPLAN
eplan.description: Installation that the EPLAN worker starts. After a change the worker restarts.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Scans the project folder regularly and analyzes new, changed and recently failed projects.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.description: Limits for analyses and uploaded files.

eplan.productBin: Bin folder of EPLAN Electric P8

help.folder: Local path, drive or UNC path. Empty: no projects from a folder, upload only.
help.filePatterns: Add with Enter, e.g. *.elk and *.zw1. Only .elk (with .edb folder) and .zw1 are projects.
help.mapping: Optional, e.g. P. Empty: UNC connection only.
help.networkUser: e.g. DOMAIN\user; empty: account of the service
help.openMode: ReadOnly does not change the project and is recommended.
help.schedulerEnabled: Off after installation: nothing is analyzed unasked.
help.cronSchedule: Quartz (sec min hour day month weekday) or classic with 5 fields.
help.analysisTimeoutMinutes: After that the analysis fails and the worker restarts.
help.retentionDays: Older versions are deleted, the current one of each project stays.

cron.previewInvalid: Not a valid cron expression or time zone.
